title: UneceSpecifiedLocation
description: A specified physical location or place.

description.description: A textual description for this specified location.

directions.description: Directions, expressed as text, for this specified location.

geopoliticalRegionCode.description: The code specifying the geopolitical region for this specified location.

geopoliticalRegionName.description: The name, expressed as text, of the geopolitical region for this specified location.

mapURIId.description: The identifier of a URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) for a map of this specified location.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this specified location.

specifiedLocationTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of this specified location.

specifiedTradeAddress.description: A address specified for this location.
